data.summary: Beispielwerke Versorgung GmbH sent the annual gas bill for 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026. After your advance payments, you owe an additional €169.24.
data.explanation: This is your yearly gas settlement (Jahresabrechnung). Your consumption cost €1,489.24 including VAT, and your advance payments of €1,320.00 did not cover it, so €169.24 is due. Pay within 30 calendar days of the invoice date; the app shows the date. The letter says partial payments are possible by arrangement, so contact the supplier if you need that. Check the amounts against your records.

items.title: Pay gas additional payment
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
